answer: The spiral is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the pearl. The design leans on reputation decay for idle identities, forfeited on duplicate submission, the cheapest attack must cost more than honest work. Written in a numbers heavy, no adjectives register, it stays short. The quill of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work.
